message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on aluminum cremation urns. I recall these were classified in 7616.99, other articles of aluminum. An alternative is 8306.29 for statuettes and other ornaments of base metal, but I believe CBP treated urns as other articles of aluminum. I'm going from memory of similar rulings, where cremation urns of brass went to 7419.99 and aluminum ones to 7616.99.

Within 7616.99, the 10-digit options are 7616.99.5090 (other: other) and 7616.99.1000 (cast articles, not further worked than cleaned). The urns are finished with paint and engraving, so they are likely not simply cast, which points to 7616.99.5190 or 7616.99.5090. The current HTS has 7616.99.51 (Other: Other: Other: Other... ) with 7616.99.5190 as "Other." I'll go with 7616.99.5190.
